# Traefik — custom-to-root-context-push-url

custom-to-root-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. The push URL resolves against the backend context, so the browser asks for /app/VAADIN/push and stripPrefix hands /VAADIN/push to the backend.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# custom-to-root-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push.
#
# Identical to custom-to-root-context/vaadin.yml, including its /test-redirect
# breakage: Traefik still cannot rewrite a response here. The relocated push
# URL resolves against the backend context, so the browser asks for
# /app/VAADIN/push and stripPrefix hands /VAADIN/push to the backend.
#
# So this scenario documents a real breakage rather than hiding it:
# /app/test-redirect answers `Location: /hello-flow`, without the /app prefix,
# because the backend's context path genuinely is the root and the response is
# passed through untouched. The Apache and NGINX siblings repair that with
# ProxyPassReverse / proxy_redirect. Every Kubernetes ingress behaves like this
# one, which is the reason the scenario is worth keeping as it is.
#
# custom-to-root-context-forwarded-prefix has the same rules and middlewares as
# this file, plus one environment variable on the backend, and it gets the
# redirect right. Compare the two.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/`) || Path(`/app`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - strip-app
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # stripPrefix also records what it removed in X-Forwarded-Prefix. Nothing
    # here reads it: the backend's default forward-headers strategy ignores it,
    # which is exactly what makes the redirect above wrong. On the exact path
    # /app the backend receives / rather than an empty path, so no redirect
    # rule is needed to add a trailing slash.
    strip-app:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/app"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
